outcomes.label: Real GDP growth (y/y)

definition_breaks.name: GDP rebasing
definition_breaks.note: Nigeria rebased GDP to a 2010 base year, roughly doubling measured nominal GDP and shifting the level of the series. Level comparisons across April 2014 are not meaningful.

outcomes.caption: 27 observations in the window (1999-07 to 2025-07); 286 months interpolated by the monthly spine; 21 months with no observation. Native frequency annual; Stage 3 status ok. Definition break annotated: GDP rebasing. The series stops at 2025-07, so the remainder of the window carries no observation.

outcomes.label: Headline inflation (y/y)

definition_breaks.name: CPI rebasing (2024 base year)
definition_breaks.note: The NBS rebased the Consumer Price Index in January 2025 — the first rebasing since 2009 — on a new 2024 base year with an updated basket. Headline inflation fell from 34.80% in December 2024 to 24.48% in January 2025, largely because of the rebasing rather than a change in prices (Reuters, 2025-02-18; NBS release). The World Bank's annual averages inherit this: 33.24% for 2024 against 23.01% for 2025. Comparison across January 2025 mixes disinflation with a measurement change and must be annotated, not smoothed.

outcomes.caption: 27 observations in the window (1999-07 to 2025-07); 286 months interpolated by the monthly spine; 21 months with no observation. Native frequency annual; Stage 3 status flagged. Definition break annotated: CPI rebasing (2024 base year). The series stops at 2025-07, so the remainder of the window carries no observation.

notes: One panel per outcome in analysis/specs/outcomes.yml, keyed on the outcome id, which is the metric id in the base.
An observed month is a dot; an interpolated month is a dotted segment (the imputation rule made visible); a month with no observation is nothing, and a run of them is shaded and labelled.
Counts, span, Stage 3 status and definition breaks are read from the base; the engine computes no statistic.
Each figure's byte count is recorded here and compared to the file; a figure one dbt run behind its rows fails rather than being noticed by a reader.
